normalize_simcc_tensor: normalize predicted SimCC tensors by scaling with sigma and clamping values to valid range
extract_simcc_maximum: extract maximum response locations and values from x and y axis SimCC representations
extract_heatmap_maximum: extract maximum response locations and values from 2D or batched heatmap arrays
apply_gaussian_blur_heatmap: apply Gaussian blur modulation to model predicted heatmaps with configurable kernel size
apply_batch_heatmap_nms: apply non-maximum suppression on a batch of heatmaps using max pooling with odd kernel size
